newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: DCB Holdings proposes name change.
newsitem.headline: DCB Holdings proposes name change.

text.p: Malaysian banking and financial group DCB Holdings Bhd said on Tuesday it proposes to change its name to RHB Capital Bhd.
The proposal comes after the group proposed a major restructuring exercise in 1996 which saw the merger of its banking subsidiary, DCB Bank Bhd, with Kwong Yik Bank.
If implemented, the restructuring proposal would result in RHB becoming the holding company of the enlarged DCB Holdings group, said DCB in a statement.

"As a result of the restructuring proposal, and in order to reflect the change in ownership of DCB Holdings, the board of directors of DCB Holdings are proposing to change the company's name from DCB Holdings to RHB Capital Bhd," it said.
